description: Q-SYS product specs, configuration procedures, and connection guides in one local index - with equipment-list compatibility checks neither QSC website can do.

novel_features.name: Unified product card
novel_features.description: See a Q-SYS product's overview, spec-sheet text, configuration pages, and connection guidance in one record.

novel_features.name: BOM compatibility check
novel_features.description: Check a whole equipment list against a Q-SYS Designer version and get back what is supported and what is not.

novel_features.name: Deprecation sweep
novel_features.description: Flag which models in a list are deprecated or discontinued before they reach a quote.

novel_features.name: Connection guidance by model
novel_features.description: Get the networking, wiring, and I/O guidance that actually applies to a given model.

novel_features.name: BOM sweep — one report per model
novel_features.description: One report per model in an equipment list: version support, EOL status, and spec-sheet availability in a single pass.

novel_features.name: Version-aware page reads
novel_features.description: Read a help page as of a specific Q-SYS Designer version from the versioned doc tree.

novel_features.name: Extraction coverage report
novel_features.description: Report how many products resolved a spec sheet and how many pages parsed, so extraction gaps are visible.

novel_features.name: UC platform integration lookup
novel_features.description: Find which UC platforms (Teams, Zoom, Meet) a device is certified or integrated with.
